description: Returns active National Weather Service alerts (warnings, watches, advisories) for one US latitude and longitude as {source, location, count, alerts}, each with event, severity, urgency, area, times, description and instructions, usually in 1 to 2 seconds. An empty list means no active alert at that point. US government data, public domain; US points only. Read-only. Paid per call with x402; outside the US or if the service is unavailable the call fails and is not charged.

lat.description: Latitude of a US point in decimal degrees, for example 32.78.
lat.title: Lat

lon.description: Longitude of a US point in decimal degrees, for example -96.80.
lon.title: Lon

name: weather.alerts
